# Runner selection

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Release pipeline · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

release.yml/verify.yml/pages.yml use pinned GitHub-hosted images (`ubuntu-24.04`, `windows-2022`); no pull_request triggers

## What is missing

recorded runner inventory check before dispatch (tried on 2026-11-26: the repository and organization runner lists could not be read with the access available, so no self-hosted runner is assumed and the hosted images stay)
